get: This tool retrieves details about a specific entity.
Use this to fetch the current state of a record.
Example tool get_current_time: Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.
Example tool get_user_information_by_id: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their user id.
list: This tool lists all entries of a given type.
Use this to enumerate available options.
Example tool list_discoverable_agent_tools: List all agent discoverable tools that you have called.
Example tool list_discoverable_user_tools: List all tools that have been given to you by the agent.
other: This tool performs a miscellaneous action.
Use this as a general-purpose helper.
Example tool change_user_email: Change the email address for a user.
Example tool log_verification: Log a verification record after successfully verifying a user's identity.
transfer: This tool transfers the conversation to a human agent.
Use this to escalate when automated handling fails.
Example tool transfer_to_human_agents: Transfer the user to a human agent.

entity: This tool primarily takes or returns a full entity object.
Use this when the payload is a structured record.
Example tool get_current_time: Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.
Example tool get_user_information_by_name: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their name. Case Sensitive.
identifier: This tool primarily takes an identifier as input.
Use this to act on a record referenced by its id.
Example tool get_user_information_by_id: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their user id.
Example tool change_user_email: Change the email address for a user.
query: This tool primarily takes a free-text query as input.
Use this when searching by name or phrase.
Example tool transfer_to_human_agents: Transfer the user to a human agent.
Example tool get_user_information_by_email: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their email.

account: This tool belongs to the account domain.
Example tool get_credit_card_transactions_by_user: Get all credit card transactions for a user.
Example tool get_credit_card_accounts_by_user: Get all credit card accounts for a user.
agent: This tool belongs to the agent domain.
Example tool unlock_discoverable_agent_tool: Unlock an agent discoverable tool that was found in the knowledge base.
Example tool list_discoverable_agent_tools: List all agent discoverable tools that you have called.
user: This tool operates on user account data.
Use this for user profile lookup or update.
Example tool transfer_to_human_agents: Transfer the user to a human agent.
Example tool get_current_time: Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.

generic: This tool is a general-purpose helper.
Use this for utility operations not tied to data.
Example tool transfer_to_human_agents: Transfer the user to a human agent.
Example tool give_discoverable_user_tool: Pass a tool to the user so they can execute it themselves.
read: This tool only reads state and has no side effects.
Example tool get_current_time: Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.
Example tool get_user_information_by_id: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their user id.
write: This tool writes or mutates state.
Use this only after explicit user confirmation.
Example tool change_user_email: Change the email address for a user.
Example tool log_verification: Log a verification record after successfully verifying a user's identity.
